notes.title: Resolution Expansion Update
notes.content: Resolution Expansion Update: The game, which previously supported only FHD (1920x1080), has now been updated to support all resolutions.

notes.title: Large Translation Update
notes.content:
Old: Korean, English, Japanese, Turkish
New: French, Chinese, Russian, Brazilian, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian

The last post-support update for TheDawn.
Please continue to support and look forward to our individual development team's actions.
Thank you always!
